title: Running clubs in Kochi
description: A short, source-linked directory of Kochi running groups and how to check their meetups.
intro: These Kochi groups describe community runs on their own websites. Their pages may be out of date, and we have not independently confirmed the next meetup. Contact each group for its latest venue, time, joining requirements and any fees before you go. The list is alphabetical, not a ranking.

entries.name: Dawnage Run Club
entries.description: The club describes weekend group runs in Kochi followed by fitness activities and says beginners are welcome. Its page does not specify a current meeting point or time; contact the group before setting out.

entries.name: Orange Runners & Riders Club
entries.description: The Kochi-based group describes running and cycling activities, including a Saturday Kochi Island Run. Contact the club for the next meeting point, time and any joining requirements.

entries.name: Soles of Cochin
entries.description: The club describes informal group runs in Kochi at a range of paces. Its FAQ says its usual Sunday start is at Rajiv Gandhi Indoor Stadium in Kadavanthra, but locations and times can change and are shared in its Facebook group; confirm the next meetup directly.
entries.details: Group runs · venue and time need confirmation
